description: Given a supplied equality-disabled raw intuitionistic proof of \(\Gamma\vdash_X H\to\exists xB(x)\), equality-free Harrop allowed context \(\Gamma,H\), equality-free \(B\), and an original term \(r\), the specified normalization and default-term extraction return an original term \(t\) with an actual proof of \(\Gamma\vdash_X H\to B(t)\).
